page.layout: One page of text in a single central column; at the right edge a narrow strip of show-through/margin fragments from the facing page (not transcribed as notes). Running head at top above the text; page number at top left.

main_text.p: fluctus quosdam se efferentium, procellis hausti & demersi (siccum enim mare Syrtes exhibent, quod ventis agitatum, pro fluctibus arenarum cumulos versat) Horum tandem malorum impatientes, ad arma conclamare, turmatim concurrere, in Austrum, quasi in hostem (agilem illum, & ordines intercurrere subtilem) saxis & telis irruere: Sed ita furentes, & (quod hic vere dixeris) aërem verberantes, adverso turbine violentior ventus occupat, & dicto citius, universos cum omnibus copiis armisque, collibus arenarum involvit & sepelit. Silet hic Genius

page.notes: The right-hand strip contains fragments of marginal text from the facing page, too faint and cut off to read reliably; left out. Words "Genius" at line end is set right-aligned as printed.
